explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 89 named tracks across Juno's current September 2026 techno releases, adjacent house/electro listings, Hard Wax current arrivals, Boomkat new releases and overlooked catalogue windows. Written attributed descriptions and exact listings only; no audio audition.
exclusions: Jay Mitta — Sawa and Lotic — Carried remain removed after severe listener feedback; Luigi Tozzi — Tender Is The Night remains positively retained. The repaired opening was excluded from placement testing.
Completed Runs 222, 223, 225, 227, 228 and 231 selected identities were excluded; the last five completed discovery-run boundary sets were not repeated.
Every ranked artist/title pair was checked against canonical state, target-local discovery history, rejection/PARKED state and the global utility ledger.
No proposed placement splits Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer.

The top three leads come from three different releases and carry candidate-specific evidence. Lower-ranked same-release leads preserve their individual evidence rather than borrowing a generic release description.

Explicit panic-, threat-, suspense- and punishment-coded propositions were deprioritized after direct listener evidence from Sawa and Carried. This remains a run-level selection decision, not a blanket intensity or genre ban.
